seoTitle: Hazbin Hotel Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Hazbin Hotel test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Charlie, Vaggie, Alastor, Angel Dust, Husk, Niffty, Sir Pentious, Lucifer or Adam — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the optimistic princess, the smiling Radio Demon, or the grumpy bartender with surprisingly good advice? Answer 12 everyday questions about friends, deals and second chances, and find out which Hazbin Hotel character you are.

characters.name: Charlie Morningstar
characters.title: The Dreamer
characters.summary: Optimistic, kind and full of belief. You see the good in everyone, even when nobody else does.
description: Like Charlie, you believe in people. She's the princess of Hell, and she's optimistic and cares deeply about everyone.
You follow your dream. Charlie runs a hotel to help sinners find redemption.
You keep going when nobody takes you seriously. Most demons in Hell laugh at Charlie's optimism.
characters.flaw: You see the best in people, even when they don't deserve it.
characters.signature: A big smile, a song in your heart and a plan nobody else believes in.
characters.clashReason: they'd insist you could be a better person, and never give up on it

characters.name: Vaggie
characters.title: The Protector
characters.summary: Loyal, protective and quick to anger. You'll defend the people you love from anyone, and you try to keep everyone grounded.
description: Like Vaggie, you're fiercely loyal. She's Charlie's girlfriend, and she's highly supportive of her.
You keep things running. Vaggie is the hotel's manager, and she's protective of its image.
You've got a fighter's past. Vaggie used to be an exorcist.
characters.flaw: You've got a quick temper, even though you try to stay rational.
characters.signature: A sharp glare, a clipboard and someone you'd fight the world for.
characters.clashReason: they'd glare at you until you backed off

characters.name: Alastor
characters.title: The Radio Demon
characters.summary: Charming, elegant and impossible to read. You're always smiling, and nobody's quite sure what you're really thinking.
description: Like Alastor, you're charming and elegant. He's known as the Radio Demon.
You do things for your own reasons. Alastor helps Charlie's hotel purely for his own amusement.
You've got a dark side. Alastor's charming exterior hides a twisted mind.
characters.flaw: You treat other people like entertainment.
characters.signature: A never-ending smile, an old-fashioned microphone and a deal you're happy to make.
characters.clashReason: they'd smile at you, and you'd have no idea what they were planning

characters.name: Angel Dust
characters.title: The Flirt
characters.summary: Cheeky, flirty and secretly soft-hearted. You act like you don't care, but you'd do anything for your friends.
description: Like Angel Dust, you've got attitude. He's insolent, cheeky and the hotel's reluctant first guest.
You care more than you show. Angel genuinely cares about his friends.
You're trying to be better. Angel strives to improve himself, even if he won't admit it.
characters.flaw: You hide your feelings behind jokes and attitude.
characters.signature: A cheeky wink, a sharp comeback and a soft heart nobody's allowed to see.
characters.clashReason: they'd flirt with your friends and roll their eyes at you

characters.name: Husk
characters.title: The Bartender
characters.summary: Grumpy, blunt and surprisingly wise. You don't like small talk, but you give the best advice in the building.
description: Like Husk, you're grumpy but wise. He's the hotel's bartender, and he's more empathetic than he looks.
You've had your ups and downs. Husk used to be an overlord, until his gambling debts led him to make a deal with Alastor.
You're a good friend underneath it all. Husk's friendship with Angel Dust shows his softer side.
characters.flaw: You're so grumpy that people don't come to you for help.
characters.signature: A deck of cards, a grumpy look and some very good advice.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you to stop talking, then give you great advice anyway

characters.name: Niffty
characters.title: The Housekeeper
characters.summary: Energetic, odd and obsessed with keeping things clean. You can be a little creepy, but you mean well.
description: Like Niffty, you love things clean. She's the hotel's housekeeper, and she's obsessed with cleanliness.
You're a little bit strange, and that's fine. Niffty has macabre and often creepy mannerisms.
You don't mean any harm. Underneath it all, Niffty usually means well.
characters.flaw: You get so focused on one thing that you forget everything else.
characters.signature: A feather duster, a big grin and a spotless room.
characters.clashReason: they'd rearrange your whole room while you weren't looking

characters.name: Sir Pentious
characters.title: The Inventor
characters.summary: Dramatic, inventive and more sincere than you look. You want to be taken seriously, and you're secretly a big softie.
description: Like Sir Pentious, you're an inventor. He's a skilful inventor who builds his own machines.
You've had a change of heart. Sir Pentious starts out spying on the hotel, then becomes one of its guests.
You can be redeemed. Charlie's kindness touches Sir Pentious, and he's redeemed at the end of season 1.
characters.flaw: You want to be taken seriously so badly that it makes you clumsy.
characters.signature: A top hat, a grand speech and an invention that almost works.
characters.clashReason: they'd declare you their sworn enemy over something tiny

characters.name: Lucifer
characters.title: The King
characters.summary: Theatrical, funny and a big softie about family. You put on a show, but you love the people close to you more than anything.
description: Like Lucifer, you've got a flair for the dramatic. He's the King of Hell, and he has a comical, theatrical personality.
You hide your feelings behind a performance. Lucifer's humour covers up a lot of sadness.
You love your family. Lucifer genuinely loves his daughter, Charlie, even though he doubts her plan.
characters.flaw: You hide what you're really feeling behind a big performance.
characters.signature: A top hat, a show tune and a lot of feelings you're not talking about.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn a serious chat into a musical number

characters.name: Adam
characters.title: The Ego
characters.summary: Loud, confident and absolutely sure of yourself. You think you're the best, and you're not shy about saying it.
description: Like Adam, you're sure of yourself. He's the leader of the angels sent to exterminate demons.
You don't hold back. Adam is narcissistic, self-centred and immature.
You don't buy other people's dreams. Adam mocks Charlie's idea that sinners can be redeemed.
characters.flaw: You think you're the best, and you make sure everyone knows it.
characters.signature: A guitar, a loud mouth and a very big ego.
characters.clashReason: they'd make fun of your dreams to your face

questions.text: A friend tells you they want to change their life for the better. You...

options.text: Throw them a party. You believe in them completely
Support them, and watch out for anyone who'd drag them down
Shrug. People rarely change, but sure, good luck
Laugh. Seriously?

questions.text: Your home is a total mess. You...

options.text: Clean it top to bottom, then do it again
Ignore it. You've got better things to do
Get distracted by a new hobby instead
Make a cleaning rota, and enforce it
Somewhere loud, with a lot of flirting
A quiet bar, a deck of cards and no small talk
Anywhere you're the centre of attention
An old-fashioned evening, with jazz on the radio

questions.text: Someone insults you in public. You...

options.text: Laugh it off. You'll deal with them later
Fire back, instantly
Swear dramatic revenge, then trip over something
Try to understand why they're so angry

questions.text: You're roped into helping with a project you don't care about. You...

options.text: Agree, purely because it might be entertaining
Complain, then quietly do a great job
Do the bare minimum, grumbling the whole time
Get far too excited about the tiny details

questions.text: You build something you're really proud of. You...

options.text: Show it to everyone, with a big speech
Make a hundred more, just in case
Insist you were always going to be brilliant
Clean up the mess you made building it

questions.text: Someone you love has a big dream you don't think will work. You...

options.text: Worry, but secretly hope they prove you wrong
Back them all the way, and fight anyone who laughs
Encourage them, with a smile nobody can quite read
Tell them it's a stupid idea
Listen, then give surprisingly wise advice
Hug them, and promise everything will be okay
Make them laugh with a cheeky joke
Bring them something sweet, and hover nearby

questions.text: You're feeling a bit down. You...

options.text: Hide it behind jokes and a big performance
Sit quietly somewhere, and say nothing
Sing it out
Work on a ridiculous new invention

questions.text: You turn up at a party nobody invited you to. You...

options.text: Act like the guest of honour. Obviously
Make friends with the bartender immediately
Arrive fashionably late, and charm everyone
Make a grand, villainous entrance

questions.text: You run a hotel trying to redeem the worst people in the afterlife. You...

options.text: Believe in every single guest, no matter what
Run security, and keep the guests in line
Doubt it'll work, but turn up to support anyway
Keep the place spotless, whatever happens

questions.text: You're offered a powerful deal with strings attached. You...

options.text: Make the deal, but make sure you're the one holding the strings
Say no. Deals like that never end well
Take it, and plan to double-cross them later
Ask what it costs everyone else first
